said that data from a phase 2b trial found that the experimental drug inaxaplin led to a significant decline in proteinuria in individuals with APOL1-mediated kidney disease (AMKD).

Results from the AMPLIFIED study showed that in one cohort, people with AMKD with modest proteinuria had a 42.7% reduction in urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) at week 13 compared to baseline. A secondary endpoint, urine protein-to-creatinine ratio (UPCR), showed a 44.7% drop.
In the second cohort, individuals with AMKD, type 2 diabetes, and proteinuria, UACR reduction was 17.3%, while UPCR declined 25.4%.

title: Vertex reports positive mid-stage results of inaxaplin for kidney disease
